availability: Validation Active AND participation Active AND OpenToConnections=true; optional valid timezone; maintained #9 pair/group rules. Any language excluded, never wildcard.

groupSchemaGate: No per-click field/schema audit. Deployment must verify mapped OperationComplete Boolean and existing schema. Current bounded request rows require typed Id/Status/OperationComplete; missing/null/malformed values fail whole search. Accepted + OperationComplete true required for origin and each MembershipKey episode.
paging: Explicit bound/error on any next link or over-bound collection; no continuation inputs and no silent truncation. Rendering/work budgets prevent unbounded Data Operations loops; synchronous tenant latency/load still unverified.

selfServiceAccessRequirement: No routine individual participant grants; group-based sharing/access where existing tenant group is verified. Do not remove authentication or switch Invoker to owner credentials; #42 owns protected-data/caller design.
